name: Samhyun
summary: Samhyun Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of parts and accessories for motor vehicles. It offers smart actuators for the electrification of electric vehicles (EV) and fuel cell electric vehicles (FCEV); high voltage e-compressors; cooling fan modules for FCEV; EPT for xEV; DCT CA motors; shift-by-wire actuators; and CVVD actuators. The company also provides electric propulsion systems, and main components of electric vessels for the shipbuilding industry; main components of joint modules for the robot industry; smart actuators and electric propulsion systems for the defense industry; and components for UAM and hybrid drones for aviation industry. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Changwon-si, South Korea.
